description: This Java class, RotationVectorDemo, is an Android activity that demonstrates the use of the rotation vector sensor to control a 3D cube's orientation using OpenGL ES. It manages sensor registration, handles sensor events to update rotation matrices, and renders a rotating cube accordingly.
external_methods: GL10.glFrustumf(float, float, float, float, float, float)

classes.name: RotationVectorDemo
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up OpenGL view and manages sensor lifecycle for rotation vector sensor.

classes.name: RotationVectorDemo.MyRenderer
classes.description: Implements rendering logic for OpenGL and handles sensor events to update cube orientation.

classes.name: RotationVectorDemo.MyRenderer.Cube
classes.description: Represents a 3D cube object with buffers for vertices, colors, and indices, and drawing logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensor manager, OpenGL surface view, and renderer.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes sensor listening and OpenGL rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses sensor listening and OpenGL rendering.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Registers the rotation vector sensor with the sensor manager.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles sensor events, updating the rotation matrix when a rotation vector sensor event is received.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears the screen, sets up the model view, applies rotation, and draws the cube.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix when surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL parameters and background color.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the cube using OpenGL ES commands.
